descriptions.text: Swaprum, an Arbitrum-based DEX, pulled the rug for $3M on Thursday. Certik, the project's auditor, has since updated Swaprum’s security score to “Exit Scam”. Too little, too late?

The Arbitrum ecological Swaprum project has a Rug Pull, the price of SAPR has dropped by 100%, Swaprum has deleted the social account, and the scammer bridged 1628 ETH (about 2.94 million US dollars) to Ethereum and transferred it to Tornado Cash.

Swaprum, a DEX protocol on Arbitrum, was exploited on 19 May 2023 by a malicious proxy upgrade. The team introduced a backdoor function after audit, drained ~$3M in staked LP tokens, laundered proceeds through Tornado Cash, and deleted their online presence. The MasterChef staking contract was upgradeable. After an audit of clean contracts, the team used the proxy upgrade mechanism to deploy new code with a hidden backdoor add() function, enabling privileged withdrawal of user funds.
